refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback highlights two high-priority issues: (1) CQ5: Organization class lacks sufficient descriptive properties (needs VAT ID, contact information, etc.); (2) CQ13: No explicit modeling of file format constraints or required fields. Medium-priority: introduce subclass hierarchies for Organization (Buyer, Seller), Role (BuyerRole, SellerRole), and Item (Product, Service); add GCAs/equivalentClass axioms for key semantic concepts (e.g., Buyer as Organization with BuyerRole in Invoice). Low-priority: temporal aspects (invoice date, due date). No constraint violations found, but 'InvoiceDetail' is unconnected (pitfall risk).
